source: Markaz TOEFL Academy, tryout 3892, Listening Part A no 11, 17, 20, 28
catatan: Acuan gaya saja, bukan untuk disalin. Format transkrip diseragamkan dengan label MAN/WOMAN/NARRATOR.

items.transcript:
WOMAN: Are you driving to work today?
MAN: Not unless the buses stop running.
NARRATOR: What does the man mean?

options.A: He intends to take public transportation.
options.B: He doesn't know how to drive.
options.C: He forgot where he parked his car.
options.D: He plans to leave work early.

items.transcript:
WOMAN: Did your manager like your proposal?
MAN: He didn't exactly say no.
NARRATOR: What can be inferred about the man's proposal?

options.B: It has probably not been rejected.
options.C: The manager refused to read it.

items.transcript:
WOMAN: Did you call the dentist?
MAN: It's at the top of tomorrow's to-do list.
NARRATOR: What does the man imply?

options.A: He has already spoken to the dentist.
options.B: He forgot the dentist's phone number.
options.C: He plans to call the dentist tomorrow.

items.transcript:
MAN: Can you help me carry these boxes upstairs?
WOMAN: I just got back from the gym an hour ago.
NARRATOR: What does the woman imply?

options.A: She is too tired to help right now.
options.B: She will go to the gym again later today.
options.C: She is eager to help lift the boxes.
options.D: She spends most of her time exercising.
